title: Pipeline
description: A pipeline's own declaration: src/main/pipeline/<pipeline>/pipeline.json. Its DIRECTORY is the pipeline name, so the name is not a field here — and a directory cannot hold two entries of one name, which is how uniqueness stops being a check. The filename is uniform (pipeline.json, the kind, not the instance): cli/'s <noun>.json convention marks the bare command's declaration among its verb files, a role that does not exist inside a pipeline directory, and three siblings should share one shape down to the filename. This schema lives beside what it describes rather than under rsc/schema/, which is the data domain: the pipeline declaration is this repo's own interface, not corpus data. Derivables are absent by construction: the remedy command is `corpus-yoga pipeline run <name>`, the format history is rsc/schema/<name>/<schemas[0]>/CHANGELOG.md, and the cache root comes from rsc/cache_io.csv — each a function of the name, so declaring them could only contradict the derivation.

schemas.description: The schema families this pipeline's data validates against, each by its address under rsc/schema/pipeline/<pipeline>/ - <provider>/<family> where the family's instances are one provider's, <family> otherwise (#632) - so that two providers' families of one name are two entries. Order is load-bearing: the FIRST entry is the schema whose CHANGELOG.md anchors the pipeline's format history.

input.description: The repo-relative directory under data/input/ the pipeline reads. The one committed authority for this path: run.sh reads it from here rather than restating it. A literal <provider> segment stands for each provider the `provider` member names, one store each (#635).

input_glob.description: The glob under input that selects one datum. A trailing slash selects directories; no trailing slash selects files.

provider.description: The providers the pipeline reads, each a row of rsc/provider/providers.csv with a mechanism directory of its name beside the declaration, and each with the globs that select its data under its own store: a provider writes a session as its harness does, a file or a directory. Present exactly when input carries <provider>; the cache then holds one directory per provider under the pipeline's root.

input_glob.description: The glob under this provider's input that selects one datum.

extra_input_glob.description: A second input shape beyond input_glob, at the same subject depth. Empty when the provider has one shape.

subject_depth.description: How many path components under the pipeline's cache root name one subject - under each provider's directory of that root, where the input is per provider.

extra_input_glob.description: A second input shape the pipeline demands beyond input_glob, at the same subject depth; the trailing-slash convention is per glob. Empty when the pipeline has one shape.

diagnostic_skip.description: Diagnostics to skip beyond the universal versioned-schema skip set, by the family that deviates: each key one of `schemas`, each value the diagnostics that family is licensed to fail, named for the deviation. A skip belongs to the family that needs it, so a family declared beside it loses no check. Empty when no family deviates.
